newsitem.title: UK: PowderJect offers shares at 185p in placing.
newsitem.headline: PowderJect offers shares at 185p in placing.

text.p: Britain's PowderJect Pharmaceuticals Plc, a developer of needle-free injections which shoot powdered drugs into the skin at supersonic speed, plans to raise 35.0 million stg in a share placing, Robert Flemings & Co Ltd said on Friday.
Flemings, on behalf of PowderJect, said the company was offering 18.92 million shares at 185p each, capitalising PowderJect at 109.3 million.
Flemings said no existing shares in the company were being sold.
It said the company would seek a listing on the London Stock Exchange and dealing in the shares was expected to begin on June 17.
PowderJect says its needle-free system was painless and causes no skin damage.
The company is developing a second system to inject drugs into the side of the mouth, suitable for speeding up the impact of migraine drugs and anaesthetics.
